close_reason: implemented check_algorithm: checks outer==inner OID per RFC 5280 §4.1.1.2 and OID against ALLOWED_SIG_ALGS whitelist
description:
Implement check_algorithm() in pkix-chain-simple/src/lib.rs (currently todo!() at line 321).

BLOCKED BY: PKIX-cfh (API fixes must be complete; in particular the SignatureVerifier return type fix from PKIX-q13 since this crate interacts with that layer).

What to implement:
  1. Compare cert.signature_algorithm.oid against ALLOWED_SIG_ALGS constant.
     Return Error::AlgorithmNotAllowed { index } if not found.
  
  2. Verify outer signatureAlgorithm == inner TBSCertificate.signature per RFC 5280 §4.1.1.2.
     x509-cert exposes: cert.signature_algorithm (outer) and cert.tbs_certificate.signature (inner).
     These must be equal: same OID, same parameters.
     A mismatch is a sign of certificate tampering and must be rejected.
     Return Error::AlgorithmNotAllowed { index } on mismatch (or a dedicated variant — decide and document).

Note: the algorithm check is applied to every cert in the chain including intermediates, because the simplicity contract requires a uniform algorithm profile throughout the chain. A mixed-algorithm chain (RSA leaf, ECDSA intermediate) is not considered 'simple'.
title: pkix-chain-simple: implement check_algorithm
